faq.question: Is laptop charger allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Laptop Charger is allowed in carry-on luggage. Laptop chargers, power bricks, and charging cables are allowed in carry-on bags. They do not contain battery storage cells.

faq.question: Can you pack laptop charger in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Laptop Charger is allowed in checked bags. Laptop chargers are allowed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can I put my laptop charger in checked luggage?
faq.answer: Yes! Standard laptop chargers, cords, and power bricks contain no internal battery cells and are 100% allowed in checked baggage as well as carry-on luggage on all airlines.

faq.question: Do laptop chargers have lithium batteries?
faq.answer: No. Wall chargers and power adapters do not store energy and contain zero lithium batteries. Only portable power banks / external battery packs contain lithium cells (which must stay in carry-on).
